reason: The only offered action connects the cylinders to the processor's carbon-dioxide outlet, matching the collection goal.
expectation: I expect the cylinders to collect carbon dioxide from the working processor, though the details of storage are uncertain.

effect: The carbon dioxide is collected without interrupting oxygen production, and its role alongside water-derived hydrogen in making methane is clearer.
reaction: The connection between breathing support and fuel production was satisfying, though the action itself was predictable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Collecting carbon dioxide tied the existing processor to the return fuel plan and clarified that oxygen production continues.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter's sole action was straightforward and offered no meaningful decision.

surprise.text: The carbon dioxide is taken off before the oxygen-making cell while the breathing-oxygen line keeps running.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary; connecting a cylinder to the designated outlet had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the collected gases become fuel, although this chapter alone offered little gameplay choice.
